Hi Klemens,

Thank you for reaching out. First, I just want to confirm that the dataset you are using is a TMT experiment? The `FragPipetoMSstatsPTMFormat` converter currently does not support label free acquisitions, although I plan on adding LF shortly (we just added a FragPipe LF converter to the MSstats package).

Second, can you ensure you are on the most recent version of FragPipe? We have been developing this converter in conjunction with the FragPipe team and they have made changes on their end that affect what columns are added to the `msstats.csv` file.

In any case, would you be able to post a small reproducible example? Even if you are running a label free experiment I might be able to implement a limited converter with your data.

Best,
Devon

On Friday, July 7, 2023 at 6:04:32 AM UTC-4 froehlic...@gmail.com wrote:
Dear Developers

We are currently looking to combine phospho analysis of DDA data using FragPipe and MSstatsPTM.

I have noticed that there is a nice converter tool:

MSstatsPTM::FragPipetoMSstatsPTMFormat

Which states in the description:

input
data.frame of msstats.csv file produced by Philosopher 

which looks like this:

> PO %>% colnames() [1] "ProteinName" "PeptideSequence" "PrecursorCharge" "FragmentIon" [5] "ProductCharge" "IsotopeLabelType" "Condition" "BioReplicate" [9] "Run" "Intensity"

when I tried to run the converter it (rightfully) complained that I forgot to specify the FASTA file. However, how can I specify the fasta file in the converter? This argument seems to be missing (I would expect something like fasta_path).

Also does not work to provide a workaround with "Start" column in the msstats.csv output of philospher. The converter still wants to have a fasta AND complains that the Start column is missing.

Additionally, I found the argument

localization_cutoff

Minimum localization score required to keep modification. Default is .75.


somewhat confusing as the output of philosopher does not contain any site confidence score.

If you need a small reproducible example I would be happy to provide one for you, but I think I must have a different input than whoever wrote the adapter?

I am using the msstats.csv file generated by FragPipe upon activating the msstats.csv output in the VALIDATION tab. It is then generated in the overall experiment folder of the FragPipe search. Is this the correct output?

Best, Klemens
